description: This file defines a decorator class for CSS attribute validation within the HTMLPurifier library, specifically handling the use of '!important' in CSS values.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ImportantDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that enables the handling of '!important' in CSS attribute values, wrapping another attribute definition and modifying its validation behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a definition to wrap and an optional flag to allow '!important'.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Intercepts the CSS value string to detect and potentially remove '!important', then delegates validation to the wrapped definition, restoring '!important' if allowed and detected.
